mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.5%, it signals a severe economic downturn that increases earnings risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, signaling strong corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST > 550 and RSAFS > 350000) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During zero interest rate policy (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 10%) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 350,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer spending that drives corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 350000 over a 3-year rolling window.
